purpose: User-approved fresh alternating current v7 versus v4 Parallel comparison after historical peak comparison. Compare formats in the same retained executable rather than different software cohorts.
scope: Measurement only; no source edits, builds, optimization, push, PR or adoption. Keep current retained implementation and stop for review after all four cells.
configuration: Fresh local ext4;1KiB values,2GiB targetSST,no compaction,explicit Parallel. V4 ordinary WAL without PITR;v7 with PITR enabled to select v7. This compares supported configurations, not wire framing alone. Batch64:750000 puts/sample10 at16,8,1writers. Point8:100000 puts/sample100.
schedule: Batch16 two warmups+5 alternating v4/v7 pairs;batch8,point8,batch1 each two warmups+3 alternating pairs. Odd pairs v4 then v7;even reverse. All36 invocations run regardless of ratios;no retries/replacements/peak-selected repeats.30s initial cooldown per cell,10s gaps. Host audit before/during1Hz/after. No concurrent source edit/build/test/profile or active SMART polling.
stall_policy: Preserve every raw record. Reuse combined mask:mean fdatasync>=1.5ms in either format OR mean v7 FRONTIER write>=1ms. Exclude a matched pair if either invocation is flagged. Also report a symmetric sync-only mask and raw comparisons. V4 has no FRONTIER write, so combined mask is asymmetric and could hide a real v7-specific cost; it is descriptive, not qualification. Both aggregate masks miss short outliers and DATA/preparation delays. Report counts/arm-specific flags; do not label remaining runs stall-free.
analysis: Report all raw and combined/sync-only paired throughput,p99,CPU,RSS,sync count and DATA-byte ratios. Formats have different padding/frame sizes, so DATA equality is diagnostic rather than a guard. Include separate-arm medians and per-format scored peaks with p99 from each peak run. No assertion of parity unless evidence supports it;no new retention decision.
correctness: Reuse exact matching1972-test/6-focused-test/full-check/release evidence from retained eligibility candidate. Verify all128 input hashes,source commit and executable SHA before capture. No rebuild or correctness rerun for unchanged source.
